setup.command:
cat > /tmp/makepdf.py << 'PY'
# minimal PDF writer with correct xref, stdlib only
def make_pdf(path, lines):
    objs = []
    objs.append("<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R >>")
    objs.append("<< /Type /Pages /Kids [3 0 R] /Count 1 >>")
    objs.append("<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 612 792] /Contents 4 0 R /Resources << /Font << /F1 5 0 R >> >> >>")
    # content stream
    y = 750
    stream_lines = ["BT", "/F1 12 Tf"]
    for text in lines:
        esc = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
        stream_lines.append(f"50 {y} Td ({esc}) Tj")
        # reset position trick: move back
        # use Td relative; simpler: use Tm absolute per line
        # redo with Tm:
        stream_lines.pop()
        stream_lines.append(f"BT /F1 12 Tf 50 {y} Td ({esc}) Tj ET")
        y -= 20
    # Actually wrap: we already have BT open; simplify: join
    stream = "\n".join(stream_lines[2:]) if len(stream_lines)>2 else ""
    # rebuild cleanly
    parts = []
    for i, text in enumerate(lines):
        esc = text.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("(", "\\(").replace(")", "\\)")
        yy = 750 - i*20
        parts.append(f"BT /F1 12 Tf 50 {yy} Td ({esc}) Tj ET")
    stream = "\n".join(parts) + "\n"
    objs.append(f"<< /Length {len(stream.encode())} >>\nstream\n{stream}endstream")
    objs.append("<< /Type /Font /Subtype /Type1 /BaseFont /Helvetica >>")
    out = bytearray()
    out += b"%PDF-1.4\n"
    offsets = [0]
    for i, body in enumerate(objs, start=1):
        offsets.append(len(out))
        out += f"{i} 0 obj\n{body}\nendobj\n".encode()
    xref_pos = len(out)
    out += f"xref\n0 {len(objs)+1}\n0000000000 65535 f \n".encode()
    for off in offsets[1:]:
        out += f"{off:010d} 00000 n \n".encode()
    out += f"trailer\n<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>\nstartxref\n{xref_pos}\n%%EOF".encode()
    open(path, "wb").write(out)
    print(f"wrote {path} {len(out)} bytes")

lines = [
    "Hello Marker Test Document",
    "This is a paragraph for conversion testing.",
    "Name Age City",
    "Alice 30 Paris",
    "Bob 25 London",
    "def hello(): print('hi')",
]
make_pdf("/tmp/sample.pdf", lines)

Pillow: Argument Injection in Ghostscript call, potentially leading into RCE
filelock ReadWriteLock: SQLite reopens the lock database by name, so a planted symlink or journal file makes the lock user's process overwrite or unlink its own files
Pillow: Infinite loop in MIC n_frames when the embedded TIFF
Pillow: NULL dereference in ImagingExpand via rank filters on zero-size images
Pillow: TarIO negative size field causes infinite CPU-spin loop
Pillow `BdfFontFile`: `Image.new()` called without `_decompression_bomb_check()` — bomb protection bypass via font loading
Pillow: Out-of-bounds access in _imagingmorph on a zero-width image
Pillow: `FontFile.compile()`: `Image.new()` called without `_decompression_bomb_check()`
Pillow: APNG background disposal allocates full canvas before decompression bomb check
Pillow: Out-of-bounds read via attacker-controlled row stride on Pillow's mmap path (McIdas AREA files)
Pillow: GIF seek keeps rejected size after DecompressionBombError, allowing DoS
Pillow: Heap out-of-bounds write `Image.paste()` / `Image.crop()` via signed coordinate overflow
Pillow: Double free in ImagingScaleAffine on calloc failure via Image.transform
Pillow `PcfFontFile._load_bitmaps()`: `Image.frombytes()` called without `_decompression_bomb_check()` — bomb protection bypass via PCF font loading
Pillow: Controlled heap out-of-bounds write in Pillow `ImageCmsTransform.apply()` via output mode mismatch
Pillow: Heap over-read in WMF/EMF rendering via 16-bit dimension truncation (Windows builds)
Pillow: OOB read in TiffDecode.c tile and RGBA paths leaks heap memory into pixels
Pillow affected by out-of-bounds write when loading PSD images
Pillow: Infinite loop in PdfParser.rewrite_pages on page tree Parent cycle
Pillow: Heap buffer overflow writing JPEG comment after ICC profile fills buffer
Pillow: Decompression bomb check bypass in SpiderImagePlugin.seek() leads to unbounded allocation DoS
Pillow: MSP RLE decoder expands a tiny file into unbounded memory
Pillow: Invalid free in FreeType glyph rendering when a stroker is active
Pillow: Quadratic-time DoS in PDF save_all (PdfParser.next_object_id)
Pillow: Decompression Bomb DoS via PdfParser.PdfStream.decode()
Pillow PDF append accepts malformed shared page-tree DAG causing resource exhaustion
Pillow: Unbounded recursion parsing a PDF page tree or trailer chain (incomplete fix for CVE-2026-42310)
Pillow: TIFF encoder ColorMap plane-size mismatch causes a heap out-of-bounds read
Pillow `GdImageFile._open()`: image dimensions accepted without `_decompression_bomb_check()`
Pillow has an OOB Write with Invalid PSD Tile Extents (Integer Overflow)
Pillow: TiffDecode returns uninitialized memory as pixels for short JPEG strips
Pillow JPEG2000 tiled decode retains a growing scratch buffer and can be used for denial of service
FITS GZIP decompression bomb in Pillow
Pillow: Heap out-of-bounds write in `ImageFilter.RankFilter` via integer overflow in `ImagingExpand`
Pillow: Memory disclosure and segfault in libtiff encoder via crafted TIFF tags
